    """
    Main protocol function for PyLabRobot.

    Args:

    # ==================================================================
    # EXPERIMENTAL DESIGN: Research Question & Estimand
    # ==================================================================
    # RESEARCH QUESTION:
    #   Does reagent Formulation A produce a different effect on cell
    #   viability than reagent Formulation B when applied to identically
    #   seeded cells under identical handling conditions?
    #
    # ESTIMAND (treatment contrast):
    #   delta = mean(viability | Formulation A) - mean(viability | Formulation B)
    #
    #   - Population   : cells of the study line seeded on this plate
    #   - Endpoint     : per-well relative viability (%) measured by a
    #                    downstream assay after off-deck incubation
    #   - Replication  : n = 32 replicate wells per treatment arm
    #   - Assignment   : 64 dosed wells (columns 1-8) randomized with a
    #                    fixed seed to the two arms
    #   - Interpretation: delta < 0 => A is more cytotoxic than B
    #                     delta > 0 => A preserves viability better than B
    # ==================================================================
    print("RESEARCH QUESTION: Does Formulation A affect cell viability differently than Formulation B?")
    print("ESTIMAND: delta = mean(viability|A) - mean(viability|B), n=32 replicate wells per arm")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 1. Retrieve pre-configured deck resources
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    tip_rack = lh.get_resource("tip_rack_50ul")
    source_plate = lh.get_resource("source_plate")
    dest_plate = lh.get_resource("destination_plate")
    trough = lh.get_resource("reagent_trough")

    # Reagent trough layout: channel A1 = Formulation A, channel A2 = Formulation B
    FORM_A_CHANNEL = "A1"
    FORM_B_CHANNEL = "A2"

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 2. Design parameters
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    ROWS = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F", "G", "H"]
    N_REPS = 32          # replicate wells per treatment arm
    SEED_VOL = 20.0      # uL cell suspension per well
    REAGENT_VOL = 10.0   # uL formulation per well
    MIX_VOL = 20.0       # uL in-well mixing volume
    MIX_CYCLES = 3       # aspirate/dispense cycles per mix

    # Sanity check: final well content = 30 uL, so 20 uL mix strokes are safe
    assert MIX_VOL <= (SEED_VOL + REAGENT_VOL), "Mix volume exceeds well content"

    # Reproducible randomization of the 64 dosed wells to the two arms
    import random
    rng = random.Random(20240517)
    well_names = [f"{r}{c}" for c in range(1, 9) for r in ROWS]  # columns 1-8
    rng.shuffle(well_names)
    group_A = set(well_names[:N_REPS])   # Formulation A arm
    group_B = set(well_names[N_REPS:])   # Formulation B arm

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 3. Tip management: column-major traversal of the 96-tip rack.
    #    Budget: 8 tips (seeding) + 64 tips (dosing) = 72 tips total.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    tip_names = [f"{r}{c}" for c in range(1, 13) for r in ROWS]
    tip_index = 0

    def next_tip():
        """Return the next unused tip from the rack."""
        nonlocal tip_index
        if tip_index >= len(tip_names):
            raise RuntimeError("Tip rack exhausted: protocol requires 72 tips")
        tip = tip_rack[tip_names[tip_index]]
        tip_index += 1
        return tip

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 4. Seed cells: source_plate columns 1-8 -> matching destination
    #    columns 1-8. One tip reused per destination column.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    for c in range(1, 9):
        await lh.pick_up_tips(next_tip())
        for r in ROWS:
            await lh.aspirate(source_plate[f"{r}{c}"], vols=[SEED_VOL])
            await lh.dispense(dest_plate[f"{r}{c}"], vols=[SEED_VOL])
        await lh.drop_tips()
    print(f"Seeded 64 wells with {SEED_VOL} uL cell suspension each.")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 5. Dose both arms in randomized traversal order. Fresh tip per well
    #    to prevent cross-contamination between formulations. In-well
    #    homogenization via manual mix cycles with the same tip.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    a_count = 0
    b_count = 0
    for well in well_names:
        channel = FORM_A_CHANNEL if well in group_A else FORM_B_CHANNEL

        await lh.pick_up_tips(next_tip())

        # Aspirate formulation from the trough and dispense into the well
        await lh.aspirate(trough[channel], vols=[REAGENT_VOL])
        await lh.dispense(dest_plate[well], vols=[REAGENT_VOL])

        # In-well homogenization of seed + formulation
        for _ in range(MIX_CYCLES):
            await lh.aspirate(dest_plate[well], vols=[MIX_VOL])
            await lh.dispense(dest_plate[well], vols=[MIX_VOL])

        await lh.drop_tips()

        if well in group_A:
            a_count += 1
        else:
            b_count += 1

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 6. Run summary (documents the realized design for the analysis)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    reagent_needed_ul = N_REPS * REAGENT_VOL  # 320 uL required per channel
    print("--- EXPERIMENT SUMMARY ---")
    print(f"Research question : Formulation A vs Formulation B effect on cell viability")
    print(f"Estimand          : delta = mean(viability|A) - mean(viability|B)")
    print(f"Formulation A     : {a_count} wells, trough channel {FORM_A_CHANNEL} "
          f"(requires >= {reagent_needed_ul} uL)")
    print(f"Formulation B     : {b_count} wells, trough channel {FORM_B_CHANNEL} "
          f"(requires >= {reagent_needed_ul} uL)")
    print(f"Group A wells     : {sorted(group_A)}")
    print(f"Group B wells     : {sorted(group_B)}")
    print(f"Tips consumed     : {tip_index} / {len(tip_names)}")
    print("Next step (off-deck): incubate, then read viability assay and estimate delta.")
    print("--- PROTOCOL_SUCCESS ---")
